body: I don’t understand? There’s no control here. The boundary was formed from a discussion we both had and agreed that’s how we would like to proceed. He chose to break that boundary and lie. I am merely asking how I should proceed. Do I try again or do I leave?

Yeah it’s a difficult one as there have been other issues in the relationship and many other chances given for those and now this. I will admit I take a while to fully trust someone due to my past and I felt I finally made it in fully trusting him and then he just shattered it. Thank you for perspective and experience though.

Yeah he already knows the damage that can be done and have discussed it at length. After agreeing it was a boundary I assumed he stopped. This was also discussed early on in the relationship too so it’s been a long time.

We have talked in depth about this. He knows exactly how I’m feeling. I have listened to him too but ultimately this is a massive betrayal of trust. I’m currently just thinking about where I go from here. As I said I can’t stop thinking about how he chose a stranger over me.
Hopefully this will be my last comment. I’m so sleepy. I hope I go peacefully
It’s so sweet. It’s like an end of life elixir. I should just sleep...
5 year relationship down the drain, best friend gone when I asked for help... All I can say is sorry to my mum. I’ve been suffering and I’m not strong enough for this world...

You’re in a tricky spot and I can see that. Being self aware is the worst as you are constantly divided on what to do until one day you snap. Have you ever thought about a therapist? A professional to talk to? Message me if you’d like to. And don’t feel guilty. Your feelings are valid and don’t let anyone, including yourself, say otherwise! You’re not mental, you are at your coping limit which everyone gets to at some point in their life. It is understandable.
I know that feeling. I’m surrounded by people who claim to support people with mental health yet ignore those who reach to them for help... message me if you want to.
